external_PDF_set_reason: First controlled comparison uses the same structural generator as the CFF benchmark; no claim to a real proton PDF.

physics.coupling: unchanged accepted CFF prescription; no PDF evolution or new map

covariance.type: declared synthetic full-rank correlated Gaussian on 36 boundary samples
covariance.CFF_PDF_noise_independence: declared for this synthetic experiment only
covariance.claim: Sensitivity design, not an empirical PDF covariance, universal PDF precision, prior calibration, or continuum uncertainty band

objective.interpretation: Working metric for a fixed-estimator sensitivity study; half-amplitude CFF noise retains original sigmas and is not the joint generative likelihood

representation_check.method: one fixed-seed forward-boundary output-head least-squares witness; hidden weights unchanged
representation_check.grid: linear within supported interval; checking points are staggered midpoints
representation_check.scope: Necessary forward-only finite-sample representation diagnostic, not simultaneous CFF/moment feasibility or a full fit

prospective_cases.PDF_input: Z1 central boundary with finite covariance
prospective_cases.release: after preparation review and allocated-node integration qualification

prospective_cases.PDF_input: one coherent Gaussian draw; PCG64 seed 2026102601; not generated in preparation
prospective_cases.release: only after exact-center preservation pass and review

exact_center_gates.comparison: unrounded inclusive <=; methodological safeguards, not coverage claims

development_advancement_rule: Observed-slice Hplus squared relative L2 improves beyond abs(S-S_base)<=1e-10+1e-6*max(abs(S),abs(S_base)); neither target absolute relative error worsens beyond the analogous tolerance. Report all outcomes; no retuning/reselection under v1.
later_assessment: Independent CFF/PDF noise pairs require a separate prospective specification; the existing CFF development input is already inspected.
